content: Yoɑbu Seruyɑn bii u ɡiɑ mɑ Dɑfidi sinɑ bokon ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ woowɑ win bii Abusɑlɔmun mi ɡiɑ.

Yerɑ u ɡɔrɑ Tekoɑɔ bu dɑ bu kurɔ bwisiɡii ɡoo kɑsumɑ. Ye kurɔ wi, u tunumɑ yerɑ Yoɑbu u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ɡɔɔ woorun yɑ̃nu dokeo kpɑ ɑ n sɑ̃ɑ nɡe ɑ nuki sɑnkire. A ku turɑre ɡɑɑ doke. A n ɡesi sɑ̃ɑ nɡe wi u ɡɔɔ sɔ̃ n tɛ.
À n kuɑ mɛ, kpɑ ɑ dɑ sinɑ bokon mi, ɑ nùn sɔ̃ ye kon nun sɔ̃ kpuro. Mɑ u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ ye u koo ɡere.
Mɑ kurɔ wi, u seewɑ u dɑ u kɑ sinɑ boko ɡɑri yi ko. Ye u turɑ mi, yerɑ u yiirɑ u wiru tem ɡirɑri u nɛɛ, yinni, ɑ mɑn fɑɑbɑ koowo.
Yerɑ sinɑ boko u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ n kuɑ. Mɑ u wisɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, wee, nɛ ɡɔminiwɑ. Nɛn durɔ u ɡu,
u mɑn bibu yiru deriɑ. Bii berɑ bɑ sɑnnɑ ɡberɔ. Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, ɡoo sɑri ben turuku u sere bu yɑkiɑnɑ. Mɑ turo u win winsim so u ɡo.

Tɛ̃ wee, nɛn bweseru tɑ mɑn seesi tɑ nɛɛ, n bu wi u win winsim ɡo mi nɔmu sɔndio bu mɑɑ nùn ɡo, yèn sɔ̃ u win winsim yɛm yɑri. Wee, nɑ̀ n bu bii wi nɔmu sɔndiɑ, nɑ ǹ mɑɑ bii ɡoo mɔ wi u koo nɛn durɔn tubi di, kpɑ win bweseru tu ɡbi.
Mɑ sinɑ boko u kurɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ ɡinɑ wio. Kon nɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ bu dɑ bu nun wunɛn ɡɑri yi wunɑnɑ.
Mɑ kurɔ wi, u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, bɑɑ bɑ̀ n koo ɡoo tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃, nɛ kɑ nɛn tundon yɛnuɡibɑ bɑ koo tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃, n ǹ wunɛ kɑ wunɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu.
Sinɑ boko u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɡoo ù n wunɛn kɔ̃sɑ ɡeruɑ, ɑ kɑ nùn nɑ mini. Sɑɑ yerɑ yɛ̃ro kun mɑɑ nun bɑbɑmɔ.

Mɑ kurɔ wi, u nɛɛ, ɑ mɑn nɔɔ mwɛɛru kuo kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yĩsiru, mɑ ɑ ǹ derimɔ be bɑ bii win mɔru kɔsiɑmɔ bu mɑɑ kɔ̃sɑ sosi bu nɛn bii wi u tie ɡo. Yerɑ sinɑ boko u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, sere kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn wɑ̃ɑru, wunɛn bii wi, bɑɑ win wirun seri tiɑ kun wɔrimɔ.
Mɑ kurɔ wi, u nɛɛ, yinni, ɑ de n mɑɑ ɡɑri fiiko ɡere. Yerɑ sinɑ boko u nɛɛ, ɑ ɡeruo.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ kɔ̃sɑ yeni mɔ̀ ye yɑ Gusunɔn tɔmbu wɑɑmɔ. A derɑ wunɛn tiin bii u kpikiru woo wunɛn sɔ̃. Tɛ̃, wunɛn ɡɑri yi ɑ ɡeruɑ mi, wunɑ yi kɑ yɑ̃.

Tilɑsiwɑ bɛsɛn bɑɑwure u kɑ ɡbi sɔ̃ɔ teeru kpɑ sɑ n sɑ̃ɑ nɡe nim mɛ mu yɑri tem sɔɔ, mɛ bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu mɑɑ ɡurɑ. Adɑmɑ Gusunɔ kun kĩ Abusɑlɔmu u ɡbi tɛ̃. U kĩwɑ u ɡɔsirɑmɑ kpikirun di u n wɑ̃ɑ win bɔkuɔ.
Yinni, ye nɑ kɑ nɑ wunɛn mi, nɑ nun ɡɑri yini kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɑ, nɛn tɔmbɑ bɑ mɑn bɛrum tiɑ. Yerɑ nɑ nɛɛ, kon nɑ n nun yi sɔ̃. Sɔrɔkudo kɑɑ nɛn ɡere wurɑ.
Kpɑ ɑ sun wɔrɑ nɛ kɑ nɛn bii be bɑ kɑsu bu sun ɡon nɔmɑn di, be, be bɑ ǹ kĩ sɑ n mɑɑ bɑɑ mɔ tem mɛ Gusunɔ u sun wɛ̃ sɔɔ.
Nɑ tii sɔ̃ɔwɑ nɑ nɛɛ, wunɛn ɡɑri yi koo mɑn nukuru yɛmiɑsiɑ. Domi nɑ nun mɛɛrɑwɑ nɡe Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo wi u kɔ̃sɑ kɑ ɡeɑn wunɑnɔ yɛ̃. Kpɑ Gusunɔ wunɛn Yinni u n wɑ̃ɑ kɑ wunɛ.
Mɑ sinɑ boko u kurɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ kĩ n nun ɡɑ̃ɑnu bikiɑ. A ku mɑn weesu kuɑ ɑ yen ɡɑɑ bere. Mɑ kurɔ wi, u nɛɛ, yinni, ɑ ɡeruo.

Yerɑ sinɑ boko u nɛɛ, n ǹ Yoɑbuwɑ u nun yenibɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ? Kurɔ wi, u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, sere kɑ wunɛn wɑ̃ɑru, ye ɑ ɡeruɑ mi, yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ ɡem. Wunɛn bɔ̃ɔ Yoɑbuwɑ u mɑn ɡɑri yi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, n nɑ n nun sɔ̃.
U ye kuɑwɑ n wɑ ɡɑri yi kpuro yi kɑ wɛ̃rɑ. Wee, ɑ mɑɑ bwisi mɔ nɡe Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo ɑ n kɑ yɛ̃ ye yɑ koorɑmɔ hɑnduniɑɔ.
Yen biru Dɑfidi sinɑ boko u dɑ u Yoɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, to, kon ko nɡe mɛ ɑ kĩ. A doo ɑ nɛn bii Abusɑlɔmu wi ɡɔsiɑmɑ.
Yerɑ Yoɑbu u nùn kpunɑ kɑ bɛɛrɛ u nùn siɑrɑ. Mɑ u ɡeruɑ u nɛɛ, yinni, ɡisɔrɑ nɑ wɑ mɑ ɑ kɑ mɑn nɔnu ɡeu mɛɛrɑ. Domi ɑ nɛɛ, kɑɑ ko ye nɑ nun kɑnɑ.
Mɑ Yoɑbu u seewɑ u dɑ Gesuriɔ Abusɑlɔmun mi, u kɑ nùn wurɑmɑ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ.
Ye bɑ tunumɑ, sinɑ boko u nɛɛ, ɑ de u dɑ u sinɑ win yɛnuɔ. A ku de u nɑ nɛn mi. Mɑ Abusɑlɔmu u dɑ win yɛnuɔ, u ǹ de sinɑ bokon mi.
Abusɑlɔmu kɑ Dɑfidi bɑ dorɑ
Abusɑlɔmu wi, durɔ burɔn tiiwɑ. Goo sɑri Isirelibɑ sɔɔ wi u yĩsiru yɑrɑ burɑm mɛn sɑɑbu. Sɑɑ win nɑɑ tɑrɑrun di sere kɑ win wirɔ, ɡɑm sɑri mi kɑɑ kpɑkɑ wɑ.
Wɔ̃ɔ kɑ wɔ̃ɔwɑ u rɑ win seri kɔni. Domi sɑɑ yerɑ yi rɑ nùn buniɛ too. Win seri yi bɑ kɔnɑ mi, yin bunum mu rɑ kilo yiru kere.
Bii tɔn durɔbu itɑwɑ u mɑrɑ kɑ bii tɔn kurɔ turo. Win yĩsirɑ Tɑmɑɑ. U sɑ̃ɑwɑ kurɔ burɔn tii.
Abusɑlɔmu wi, u kuɑwɑ wɔ̃ɔ yiru Yerusɑlɛmuɔ, u ǹ sinɑ boko wɑɑre.
Yerɑ u Yoɑbu sokusiɑ u nɑ u nùn ɡɔri sinɑ bokon mi. Adɑmɑ Yoɑbu u yinɑ u nɑ. Mɑ u kpɑm wure u nùn sokusiɑ. Kɑ mɛ, u yinɑ u nɑ.
Mɑ Abusɑlɔmu u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, Yoɑbun ɡberu wee nɛɡirun bɔkuɔ. U mɑɑ dĩɑnu mɔ mi. I doo i win ɡbee te dɔ̃ɔ mɛni. Mɑ bɑ dɑ bɑ tu dɔ̃ɔ mɛni.
Yerɑ Yoɑbu u seewɑ u dɑ Abusɑlɔmun mi, u nùn bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ n kuɑ wunɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ kɑ dɑ bɑ nɛn ɡberu dɔ̃ɔ mɛni.

Abusɑlɔmu u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, domi nɑ nun sokusiɑ nɑ nɛɛ, ɑ nɑ n nun ɡɔri sinɑ bokon mi, kpɑ ɑ nùn bikiɑ mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ u derɑ nɑ wurɑmɑ Gesurin di. Domi n dɑɑ sɑnɔ nɑ n woo mi ɡiɑ. Tɛ̃ nɑ kĩ su wɑɑnɑ nɛ kɑ sinɑ boko. Tɑɑrɛ ɡɑɑ yɑ̀ n mɑn wɑ̃ɑsi, kpɑ u mɑn ɡo.
Mɑ Yoɑbu u dɑ sinɑ bokon mi, u nùn ɡɑri yi tusiɑ. Yerɑ sinɑ boko u Abusɑlɔmu sokusiɑ. Ye u tunumɑ win mi, u kpunɑ kɑ bɛɛrɛ. Mɑ sinɑ boko u nùn tɔburɑ u bɔkɑsi.
Abusɑlɔmu u niɑ sɑ̃ɑ
u sinɑ boko bɑndu mwɑɑri
